name: Hala Khouri
reason: Her work is mainly somatic psychology and trauma-focused training: after 15 years as a clinician (Somatic Experiencing, MA counselling psychology), she now trains organisations in trauma-informed care, sells a 'Yoga for Trauma' manual and 'Mindful Minutes' practices to 'reduce anxiety', and her only solo book is Peace from Anxiety. Under the health and therapy rules almost nothing passes, and her Commune course is a shared Off the Mat, Into the World course led mainly by Seane Corn (already listed).
